Governmental receipts/disbursements/fund balances from Exhibit 4 (p6) Total Governmental Funds column; ending_cash from Exhibit 3 total (p4) cash and cash equivalents 15,612,590 (investments 2,480,534 and county treasurer cash 168,939 separate); beginning_cash not shown. Governmental roll-forward: 18,141,096 + 23,586,304 - 26,553,740 + transfers 0 net + bonds 3,285,000 + other financing 79,171 = 18,537,831. Business-type from Exhibit 7 (p9) enterprise funds Total column: no single total printed, so receipts = operating revenues + investment earnings + gain on disposal + misc + grant revenues + lease revenue; disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense + bond issuance cost (sum equals income before contributions 2,153,256); capital contributions 58,668 in business_type.other_financing; 54,345,759 + 2,153,256 + 58,668 = 56,557,683. Internal service fund excluded (governmental activities). Proprietary cash flow figures from Exhibit 8 (p10) enterprise Total column; no noncapital financing section printed. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total primary government column (pp1-2); component units excluded; deferred lease arrangements shown as deferred_inflows (category label required but it is a deferred inflow). Detail: recorded the more detailed fund schedules only: General Fund B-3 (p15-18, excludes Airport which is a separate B-4 schedule on p19-20; B-2 combining p14 and A-1 p12 not recorded to avoid double counting), Streets C-1 (A-2 p13 skipped as duplicate), Economic Development E-3, CDBG E-4, Keno E-5, 911 E-6, GO Debt Service F-3, Unbonded Assessments F-4, Public Safety Capital Improvements G-3 (p32) and Capital Improvements G-4 (p33) (G-3/G-4 added after the find_pages v8 re-trim; the nonmajor combining statements E-2 p23, F-2 p28 and G-2 p31 are not recorded, to avoid double counting with the fund budget schedules). Zero-actual G-4 lines (Public building improvements, Lodging tax projects) omitted. In B-3, Homestead exemption allocation and Property tax credit are included in the property tax line on A-1 (3,227,805), so high-level category is property tax with detail homestead/tax credits. B-3 'Other services and charges' and 'Contingency' recorded as not itemized; 'Personal services' as salaries and wages (includes benefits). Printed budget_final shown as final budget; '-' recorded as 0. Zero-actual lines (E-5/E-6 none, E-3 other financing, E-6 capital outlay) omitted where no actual.
